title: Ontology Suite project class/property rules
description: Minimum-required-content rules for this project, e.g. every owl:Class needs rdfs:label and rdfs:comment. Findings show up in the Problems panel and, where a safe default value exists (rdfs:label, skos:prefLabel), are offered as a Quick Fix.

appliesTo.description: CURIE or full IRI of the rdf:type this rule applies to.

requires.description: CURIEs or full IRIs of predicates that must appear at least once on every matching subject.
